Great Indian gem
Apr 2025 • Solo
Unfortunately this place doesn’t look very exciting/inviting from the outside but, having read the reviews, thought I’d give it a go and I’m SO glad I did. 

The food was fantastic. The samosas, clearly home made, with lovely dips. The lamb rogan Josh - melt in the mouth meat and really well spiced. 

The chap serving was lovely and very welcoming. 

I’d been for a ‘well reviewed’ Indian meal in Tam Coc earlier in the week, and this place beat it hands down. 

I guess it’s a little out of the way, but I like that, and it was definitely worth the effort of getting to. 

A great Indian find in Ninh Bing/Tam Coc.

Delicious, but made us both sick
Jan 2025 • Couples
My girlfriend and I went here based on the good reviews. We had a goa fish curry and a cauliflower / paneer curry, some plain rice and a garlic naan. The food was delicious, and just the right amount of spicy (we asked for medium spice). However the following morning we were both sick and this continued throughout the day. We had very different dishes but the same rice and naan, so it may have been these, or the oils the curries were cooked in or a hygiene issue with the kitchen. A shame as the food was very tasty! As some other reviews have mentioned, it is very loud in there and we were the only table in there at first (a large party of 12 did turn up during our meal).

Vietnam me indian jesa khana best roti didnt even find in india
Dec 2024 • Solo
If you’re exploring Ninh Bình and craving authentic Indian food near Mua Caves, look no further than Curry House Indian Restaurant. This hidden gem delivers a true taste of India, offering some of the best Indian cuisine I’ve had outside of India.

The menu is packed with all the classic favorites—rich, flavorful curries, perfectly spiced biryanis, and freshly baked naan that will make you feel like you’re dining back home. The flavors are spot-on, with every dish capturing the essence of traditional Indian spices and cooking techniques.

What makes Curry House stand out is its commitment to authenticity. Whether you’re indulging in a creamy butter chicken, savoring a spicy paneer tikka masala, or relishing a well-seasoned dal tadka, each dish is crafted with care and attention to detail. Vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike will find plenty of options to suit their preferences.

The restaurant itself has a warm and welcoming ambiance, and the staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. They go above and beyond to ensure you have a memorable dining experience, happily customizing spice levels or making recommendations based on your tastes.

In a town where Indian food isn’t always easy to find, Curry House Indian Restaurant is a delightful surprise. Whether you’re a solo traveler, a couple, or a family, this spot is perfect for satisfying your Indian food cravings. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Ninh Bình!
